compiler_build_scope: Integrated objects/executables and unchanged programs honor ZLLVM_EXE. Ordinary builds and native-population tools use Debug.

input_program.mode_scope: Three local release pipelines; C assertions enabled and C sanitizers disabled.
input_program.oracle: Frozen expected observations, constructed from typed values and the upstream display format; error expectations from its explicit EOF handling. LLVM must satisfy these independently.
remaining_dependencies: Pinned Zig C frontend and LLVM IR construction
Clang 22 independent optimization and code generation
System linker, CRT and libc allocation/stdio

compilation_profile.allocation_scope: logical legalizer allocator requests; allocated_bytes plus grown_bytes; excludes profiler storage; not live bytes or RSS

compiler_throughput.method: Five alternating baseline/final/profiled Fibonacci samples after two warm-ups; 25 alternating parser samples per compiler; fresh process per sample; no concurrent project validation.
compiler_throughput.limitation: Local compiler-throughput measurements; five main samples are not a statistical population claim. GNU time wall resolution is 10 ms. Profiled/unprofiled timing ranges overlap; no resolved overhead. Logical allocations are not RSS. Instrumentation-only baseline profile is one diagnostic sample.

implementation: Profile v2 adds per-function timing and per-stage outcome/allocation accounting.
Nine instruction legalizers defer copying until the first rewrite, preserving private candidate arrays and ordered search.
known_boundaries: No generated-code speedup or release optimization-quality claim.
Larger unchanged Zig input/allocation coverage remains separate future work.
Parser negative controls mutate observations, not compiler implementations.
Optional legalization retains ordered scans and original-form retries; pair/vector PHIs and spill destinations retain existing paths.
